introHtml: Box-style pen pencil cases offer structured storage that keeps writing instruments organized and protected. Unlike soft pouches, these rigid cases prevent crushing and make it easy to see contents at a glance. Ideal for corporate gift sets, school supply kits, or trade show giveaways, custom box pen pencil cases can be imprinted with your logo using screen printing or debossing. Choose from eco-friendly RPET options or classic clear plastic designs to match your brand's needs.
